name: ea-player-probe
title: Earth build T18 player probe (test only)
author: Jake Mismas
description: Test tool, never shipped. Records whether a headless run can script a player (T18, ruling 25): in on_init it looks up LuaGameScript.create_test_player, which 2.1.23's runtime-api.json lists only on LuaSimulation, and writes what it found to script-output/ea-player-probe/player.json.
